The Celtics weren't playing around about going on a transition period 😳 When the Celtics failed to repeat, Brad Stevens wasted no time making moves for the future. With Tatum out for the season with an Achilles injury, they traded away nearly half of their core for scraps. They traded Jrue Holiday for Anfernee Simons who they would trade to the Bulls midseason for Nikola Vucevic. Kristaps Porzingis was traded for Georges Niang who they then traded to the Jazz for RJ Luis and an $8 million trade exception. Despite those changes, coach Joe Mazzulla still found a way to make the Celtics one of the best teams in the east. While they did lose in the first round of the playoffs last season, they were 2nd and won 56 games. Instead of building on a 50-win season, they took a step back. 🔸Traded Jaylen Brown for a 36-year-old Paul George 🔸Signed 38-year-old Mike Conley Jr 🔸Signed Mitchell Robinson The team isn't horrible, but it does require a huge workload from Jayson Tatum to be successful. The same player who is just a year removed from his Achilles injury and had to miss game 7 of the first round. Celtics are trying to repair something that never needed to be fixed.

The Mavericks drafted skinny Luka. Sergio de Larrea isn't an exact mirror of Luka, but there are similarities in their game. ✔️Tall point guards ✔️Elite passers ✔️Doesn't rely on athleticism Let's get one thing straight. At 20 years old, de Larrea's offensive bag wasn't on par with Luka's when he was the same age. Where he does make up for it is on defense. The ironic part is that de Larrea actually idolized Luka growing up and was initially drafted by the Lakers with the no.25 pick. The Mavs were able to acquire de Larrea on draft night in exchange for two future second round picks and the rights to the no.30 pick Koa Peat. The same second round picks and no.30 pick the Mavs acquired when they traded Anthony Davis to the Wizards last season. If you really think about it, if the trade happened today de Larrea would be part of the Luka trade. Talk about a full circle moment 🙌
